question: What is the best part about doing art with friends? 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
explanation: Super! Doing art activities in a group helps us share ideas and have a lot of fun together! 😄
hint: It is about teamwork and smiles.

question: When we need a red crayon, what should we do? 🖍️
explanation: Awesome! Sharing colors with our friends makes art time very happy for everyone! 🤝
hint: We give and take kindly.

question: What do we do with a large paper in a group? 📜
explanation: Great job! We can draw a big, beautiful picture when we work together on a large paper! 🖍️
hint: We all use our colors on it.

question: After an art activity, what must we do? 🧹
explanation: Fantastic! Cleaning our desk makes the classroom look neat and tidy again! ✨
hint: We put things back in their place.

question: In a 'Guess the Animal' game, how do we play? 🦁
explanation: Brilliant! We use our body and face to act like the animal so friends can guess! 🐒
hint: We pretend to be them.

question: When we sing a song together, we make a... 🎶
explanation: Awesome! Singing together in a group makes us a wonderful and happy choir! 🎤
hint: We sing in one sweet voice.

question: What can we make by folding paper together? 📄
explanation: Super! We can fold colorful paper to make cute little boats to float in water! ⛵
hint: They float on puddles.

question: When our friend draws a beautiful tree, we should... 🌳
explanation: Great job! Cheering and clapping for our friends makes them feel very happy! 👏
hint: We show them we like it.

question: In a fun rhythm game, what do we tap? 🥁
explanation: Fantastic! Tapping our feet helps us make a great musical beat together! 🦶
hint: They have toes.

question: What can we build using clay together? 🏺
explanation: Brilliant! We can join all our clay pieces to build a huge and beautiful castle! 🏰
hint: It is a big house for a king.

question: If we mix yellow and blue paint, we get... 🎨
explanation: Awesome! Mixing yellow and blue in a painting activity creates a lovely green color! 🟢
hint: It is the color of grass.

question: How do we make a long paper chain? 🔗
explanation: Super! We link paper circles together to make a beautiful, long chain! 🎀
hint: We stick them one inside the other.

question: When dancing in a circle, we hold... 💃
explanation: Great job! Holding hands keeps us in a perfect circle while dancing together! 🤝
hint: We connect with our fingers.

question: What can we collect from the garden for a collage? 🌿
explanation: Fantastic! Dry leaves and flowers make amazing patterns in a nature collage! 🍂
hint: They fall from trees.

question: In a drawing game, who guesses the picture? 🖼️
explanation: Brilliant! We draw something funny on the board and our friends try to guess what it is! 🧒
hint: The classmates sitting with you.

question: What do we use to make handprint art? ✋
explanation: Awesome! We dip our hands in wet paint and press them on paper to make handprints! 🎨
hint: It is colorful and a little messy.

question: When playing musical statues, we stop moving when... 🛑
explanation: Super! In this fun game, everyone must freeze like a statue when the music stops! 🔇
hint: There is no more sound.

question: How can we make our classroom look beautiful? 🏫
explanation: Great job! Hanging our group drawings makes the classroom bright and colorful! 🖼️
hint: We stick our paintings on the wall.

question: What can we make using an empty cardboard box? 📦
explanation: Fantastic! A team can paint and cut a big box to make a beautiful toy house! 🏠
hint: Dolls can live in it.

question: If your friend forgets their eraser, you can... ✏️
explanation: Brilliant! Sharing our art tools helps everyone finish their activities happily! 😊
hint: You let them use yours.

question: What do we follow when clapping in a group? 👏
explanation: Awesome! Following the beat helps the whole group clap at the exact same time! 🎵
hint: It goes 1, 2, 3, 4.

question: How do we make a funny face mask? 🎭
explanation: Super! We draw a face on paper, color it, and carefully cut it out to wear! ✂️
hint: We use crayons and scissors.

question: When we work as a team, art becomes... ⭐
explanation: Great job! Working together makes big art projects fast, easy, and super fun! 🎈
hint: It is like a fun game.

question: What can we string together to make a necklace? 📿
explanation: Fantastic! We put a string through colorful beads to make lovely jewelry together! 🔴
hint: Small round objects with holes.

question: In a puppet show activity, we use our... 🎭
explanation: Brilliant! We use our hands to move the puppet and our voice to make it talk! 🗣️
hint: We speak for the puppet.

question: What do we make when we all stamp our feet? 👣
explanation: Awesome! Stamping together creates a powerful and loud beat in the room! 🥁
hint: It sounds like a big drum.

question: How do we show a happy feeling in our play? 😊
explanation: Super! A big smile is the best way to act out a happy feeling! 😁
hint: We show our teeth and look joyful.

question: What tool helps us cut paper shapes safely? ✂️
explanation: Great job! Safety scissors are made specially for children to cut paper easily and safely! ✂️
hint: They have round tips.

question: What do we use to stick paper pieces together? 🧩
explanation: Fantastic! A glue stick helps us paste paper pieces firmly onto our scrapbook! 🧴
hint: It makes things sticky.

question: What can we draw with colorful chalks outside? 🖍️
explanation: Brilliant! Drawing a hopscotch grid with friends is a great outdoor art game! 🔢
hint: We draw boxes with numbers to jump in.

question: When doing a group dance, we must... 👯
explanation: Awesome! A group dance looks amazing when everyone moves to the music together! 💃
hint: We copy the same steps.

question: What sound do we make for a sleeping lion? 🦁
explanation: Super! Making a gentle 'Zzzz' sound acts out a sleeping and snoring lion! 😴
hint: It is the sound of sleeping.

question: What makes a group song sound very sweet? 🎵
explanation: Great job! When all voices blend together happily, the song sounds wonderful! 🎤
hint: We sing in rhythm as a team.

question: If we make a mistake in drawing, we can... ✏️
explanation: Fantastic! In art, mistakes are okay! We just erase and try again happily! 🌟
hint: We never stop practicing.

question: What do we use to make a thumbprint tree? 🌳
explanation: Brilliant! Dipping our thumbs in green paint makes beautiful leaves for our tree! 👍
hint: The short, thick finger on our hand.

question: In a passing game, what do we pass to the music? 🎁
explanation: Awesome! In 'Pass the Parcel', we keep passing the box until the music stops! 📦
hint: A wrapped box with a surprise.

question: What can we make with old newspapers? 🗞️
explanation: Super! Reusing newspapers to make paper bags is a great art and craft activity! 🛍️
hint: We use them to carry things.

question: How do we learn a new art activity? 🎨
explanation: Great job! Watching the teacher carefully helps us learn exactly how to do the new craft! 👩‍🏫
hint: We look and listen to instructions.

question: What is a fun way to use vegetable slices in art? 🥔
explanation: Fantastic! Sliced vegetables dipped in paint make wonderful stamped patterns on paper! 🎨
hint: We use ladyfinger and potato.

question: When we finish a team painting, we feel... 🖼️
explanation: Brilliant! Creating something beautiful with our friends fills our hearts with pride! 😇
hint: We feel really good about our work.

question: What can we paint on a smooth river stone? 🪨
explanation: Awesome! Painting stones to look like little bugs or animals is a really fun activity! 🐞
hint: A small red insect with spots.

question: In a shadow game, what do we need? 👥
explanation: Super! We use our hands in front of a light to make cool animal shadows on the wall! 🔦
hint: A dark room and a torch.

question: What do we do before starting a messy art activity? 🎨
explanation: Great job! Wearing an art apron keeps our school uniform clean and safe from paint! 🎽
hint: It covers your shirt.

question: What happens when we blow colorful soapy bubbles? 🫧
explanation: Fantastic! Blowing bubbles is a fun activity, and they gently float up in the air! 🎈
hint: They go high into the sky.

question: How do we make the sound of rain together? 🌧️
explanation: Brilliant! Snapping our fingers and tapping our laps sounds exactly like falling rain! 🫰
hint: We use our fingers and legs gently.

question: What can we build using wooden blocks? 🧱
explanation: Awesome! Working together, we can stack blocks to build very tall towers! 🏙️
hint: Big buildings reaching high.

question: How do we show a flying bird in our dance? 🦅
explanation: Super! Moving our arms up and down makes us look like beautiful birds flying! 🪽
hint: We pretend they are wings.

question: What can we make by joining colorful ice-cream sticks? 🍦
explanation: Great job! Gluing sticks together creates a useful stand to keep our pencils and colors! 🖍️
hint: A box for your stationery.

question: When displaying our art, who comes to see it? 👀
explanation: Fantastic! We hold art exhibitions so our parents and friends can see our lovely work! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
hint: The people who love us.

question: Art activities teach us to be very... 🌟
explanation: Brilliant! Art helps us use our imagination and brings a lot of joy to our hearts! 🎨
hint: Full of bright ideas and smiles.
